ayahOccurrences.text: لَآ إِكْرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشْدُ مِنَ ٱلْغَىِّ ۚ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلطَّٰغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: ٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُمُ ٱلطَّٰغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ ٱلنُّورِ إِلَى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: قُلْ هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكَ مَثُوبَةً عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ مَن لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُ وَغَضِبَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْقِرَدَةَ وَٱلْخَنَازِيرَ وَعَبَدَ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ عَن سَوَآءِ سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ مَغْلُولَةٌ ۚ غُلَّتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَلُعِنُوا۟ بِمَا قَالُوا۟ ۘ بَلْ يَدَاهُ مَبْسُوطَتَانِ يُنفِقُ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ ۚ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَٰنًا وَكُفْرًا ۚ وَأَلْقَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ كُلَّمَآ أَوْقَدُوا۟ نَارًا لِّلْحَرْبِ أَطْفَأَهَا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَسْتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ تُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۗ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَٰنًا وَكُفْرًا ۖ فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَوْ يُعَجِّلُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ ٱلشَّرَّ ٱسْتِعْجَالَهُم بِٱلْخَيْرِ لَقُضِىَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَجَلُهُمْ ۖ فَنَذَرُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلرُّءْيَا ٱلَّتِىٓ أَرَيْنَٰكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَٰنًا كَبِيرًا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ is in the derivative form: طُغْيَان
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ط/غ/و-ى   ṭ–gh–w/y (of a liquid) to overflow, to transgress, to exceed the limits, to be excessive, to violate established norms, to be tyrannical, tyranny. The word طَغُوت ṭaghūt, which is classified under this root, is recognised by ʾal-Suyūṭī as a borrowing from Ethiopian, meaning كَاهِن kāhin (diviner, priest), while the majority of Arab philologists, however, consider it to be a genuine Arabic word. Western scholars generally regard it as a loan from either Hebrew or Aramaic.

Of this root, 8 forms occur 39 times in the Qur’an:
طَغَى ṭaghā 12 times; أطْغَى ʾaṭghā (1) 1 time; طاَغُون ṭāghūn 6 times; أطْغَى ʾaṭghā (2) 1 time; طاَغِيةٌ ṭāghiyatun 1 time;طَغْوَى ṭaghwā 1 time; طُغْيَان ṭughyān 9 times and طاَغُوت ṭāghūt 8 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
طُغْيَان ṭughyān [v. n./n.]

1 transgressing, acting wickedly; tyranny, rebellion

(17:60) ‏وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ‏ ‏فَمَا‏ ‏يَزِيدُهُمْ‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏ ‏طُغْيَانًا‏ ‏كَبِيرًا‏ We warn them, but it only increases them in great rebellion

2 obstinacy

(6:110) وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْئِدَتَهُمْ وَأَبْصَارَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَنَذَرُهُمْ فِى طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ We will make their hearts and their eyes waver, just as they did not believe in it the first time, and leave them to flounder in their obstinacy.

entries.label: طُغْيَان
entries.definitionHtml:
طُغْيَان ṭughyān [v. n./n.]

1 transgressing, acting wickedly; tyranny, rebellion

(17:60) ‏وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ‏ ‏فَمَا‏ ‏يَزِيدُهُمْ‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏ ‏طُغْيَانًا‏ ‏كَبِيرًا‏ We warn them, but it only increases them in great rebellion

2 obstinacy

(6:110) وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْئِدَتَهُمْ وَأَبْصَارَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَنَذَرُهُمْ فِى طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ We will make their hearts and their eyes waver, just as they did not believe in it the first time, and leave them to flounder in their obstinacy.

entries.label: أطْغَى
entries.definitionHtml:
أطْغَى ʾaṭghā (1) [v. IV, trans.] to cause to violate the norms of goodness

(50:27) ‏‏رَبَّنَا‏ ‏مَا‏ ‏أَطْغَيْتُهُ‏ our Lord, I did not make him transgress.

entries.label: أَطْغَى
entries.definitionHtml:
أَطْغَى ʾaṭghā (2) [elat.] more/most tyrannical

(53:52)‏كَانُوا‏ ‏هُمْ‏ ‏أَظْلَمَ‏ ‏وَأَطْغَى‏ they themselves were even more unjust and more tyrannical‏.

entries.label: طاَغُوت
entries.definitionHtml:
طاَغُوت ṭāghūt [n.]

1 [generic for] false deity/deities

(2:256)‏ فَمَنْ يَكْفُرْ بِالطَّاغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى so whoever rejects false gods and believes in God has taken grasp of the firmest link

2 [generic for] evil powers; variously named by the interpreters as: the Devil, diviners, enchanters, any head or leader in error, the idol ʾal‐lāt (q.v.) or Kaʿb ʾibn ʾal-ʾashraf, a Jewish man who directed hostilities against the new religion

(4:60) يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَتَحَاكَمُوا إِلَى الطَّاغُوتِ وَقَدْ أُمِرُوا أَنْ يَكْفُرُوا بِهِ they desire to seek the arbitration of false idols (or, leaders of disbelievers) when they have been ordered to reject them?

entries.label: طاَغُون
entries.definitionHtml:
طاَغُون ṭāghūn [pl. of act. part. طاَغِى ṭāghı] those who transgress the limits in wickedness, those who behave tyrannically

(37:30) وَمَا‏ ‏كَانَ‏ ‏لَنَا‏ ‏عَلَيْكُمْ‏ ‏مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ‏ ‏بَلْ‏ ‏كُنْتُمْ‏ ‏قَوْمًا‏ ‏طَاغِينَ‏‏ we had no power over you, but you were people [already] exceeding the limits.

entries.label: طاَغِيةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
طاَغِيةٌ ṭāghiyatun [quasi-act. part./n.] overpowering calamity

(69:5) فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِالطَّاغِيَةِ as for Thamūd they were destroyed by an overpowering calamity.

entries.label: طَغَى
entries.definitionHtml:
طَغَى ṭaghā a [v. intrans.]

1 (of water) to overflow, to be tumultuous

(69:11) إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَى الْمَاءُ حَمَلْنَاكُمْ فِى الْجَارِيَةِ when the water flooded We carried you in the sailing vessel

2 to violate the established norms of justice

(55:8) أَلاَّ‏ ‏تَطْغَوْا‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏الْمِيزَانِ‏ so that you do not transgress [the norms of justice] in weighing [judgement]

3 to become tyrannical

(20:24) اذْهَبْ‏ ‏إِلَى‏ ‏فِرْعَوْنَ‏ ‏إِنَّهُ‏ ‏طَغَى go to Pharaoh, for he has truly become tyrannical

4 to veer away, to wander off, to quit, to go off the mark

(53:17) مَا‏ ‏زَاغَ‏ ‏الْبَصَرُ‏ ‏وَمَا‏ ‏طَغَى‏ [his] sight never wavered, nor did it wander.

entries.label: طَغْوَى
entries.definitionHtml:
طَغْوَى ṭaghwā [n.] transgression, wickedness, rebellion

(91:11) كَذَّبَتْ‏ ‏ثَمُودُ‏ ‏بِطَغْوَاهَا‏ the people of Thamūd called [their messenger] a liar, because of their transgression.
